reviews.title: Read Reviews on the Software before considering.
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] The fans turn on and the pump cools, so the physical product is probably decent. The software for Thermaltake is garbage and has been for years. I installed this on a Windows 11 fresh install and nothing works, the software won't recognize the fans so they just run at a constant speed. I can change the info on the screen because it doesn't recognize that either. It just doesn't work at all. Literally a waste of a product.
reviews.author: Josh
